categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of high-quality silicon carbide (SiC) semiconductor substrates. It also engages in the manufacturing and sales of functional materials, electronic semiconductor materials, semiconductor device parts, optoelectronic devices, power electronic devices, and related equipment. The company operates in the advanced semiconductor materials industry with a focus on wide bandgap semiconductor materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered core technologies covering all stages of SiC substrate production, including equipment design, thermal field design, powder synthesis, crystal growth, substrate processing, and quality inspection. It pioneered the use of liquid phase growth methods for defect-free 8-inch SiC substrates and low-resistance P-type SiC substrates. Advanced precision processing technologies such as multi-wire slicing, global polishing, and surface cleaning are employed. The company also integrates AI and digital technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and operates smart factories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include over half of the world's top ten power semiconductor device manufacturers. The company's SiC substrates are widely used in downstream applications such as electric vehicles, photovoltaic power generation, energy storage, AI data centers, smart grids, and advanced communication base stations. The company serves global markets with a focus on high-growth sectors like renewable energy and AI technology.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jinan and Shanghai, and has established subsidiaries and sales offices in Japan, Singapore, Germany, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and other regions. It serves customers globally, with over 57% of sales revenue coming from overseas clients. The company maintains a global sales and service network covering China, Europe, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the silicon carbide semiconductor device supply chain, focusing on the production of SiC substrates which are critical raw materials for downstream semiconductor device manufacturers. It also engages in procurement of raw materials and equipment, and collaborates closely with upstream suppliers and downstream customers to build a cooperative ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining technological leadership in SiC substrate production, expanding large-diameter substrate capabilities (notably 8-inch and pioneering 12-inch substrates), and reducing production costs. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on crystal growth defect control, powder synthesis, electrical performance control, and precision processing. It aims to broaden applications in new fields such as AI glasses, smart grids, and advanced power devices, while strengthening intellectual property protection and innovation management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of silicon carbide semiconductor substrates and related semiconductor materials. The company uses a direct sales model, providing products and technical services to global semiconductor manufacturers. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader and innovator in the wide bandgap semiconductor materials industry, ranking among the top three worldwide in conductive SiC substrate market share. It is recognized as the second largest global manufacturer of conductive SiC substrates with a 22.8% market share. The company competes with other major SiC substrate producers by leveraging advanced technology, large-scale production capacity, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.77 billion, representing a 41.37% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 179 million. Total assets reached RMB 7.36 billion, growing 6.44% from the previous year. The company has maintained continuous revenue growth over the past three years, driven by expanding production capacity and market demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced quality and continuous innovation in SiC substrates, offering a broad product portfolio including 4-inch, 6-inch, 8-inch, and pioneering 12-inch substrates with superior electrical and physical properties. Its proprietary liquid phase growth technology and defect control techniques enable near-zero defect densities and high production yields. The company’s smart factory and AI-driven manufacturing processes ensure consistent high-quality delivery, supporting customers in reducing costs and enhancing device performance across emerging high-growth sectors.
